ev_note: Measured on Apple M1 Pro (CPU), 2026-10-14: 24 QASPER validation papers (arXiv PDFs, latest version), 107 distinct evidence paragraphs behind 58 questions with text evidence. Bars: evidence paragraphs by the share of their word trigrams found in the output (intact 90% or more, damaged 50 to 90%, lost under 50%; QASPER's BIBREF and INLINEFORM placeholders excluded). Recall@3: BM25 (root settings) over the root's 256-token chunks of each output, a hit when a top-3 chunk covers at least half of an evidence paragraph. With 58 questions a difference under about 15 points in recall is within noise. Top row: QASPER's own S2ORC text of the same papers, the root's starting point. Script: src/scripts/score_qasper.py.
olm_note: Measured on Apple M1 Pro (CPU), 2026-10-14, every tool at its default settings. Seeded sample (seed 0) of olmOCR-bench at revision 54a96a6f: 25 PDFs each from multi column, headers and footers, tables and old scans, 10 from long tiny text; tests restricted to those PDFs (counts in the header). Score per category = share of its tests passed, as the benchmark computes it; Mean = mean of the five categories, with a 95% bootstrap interval over PDFs. The two maths categories, which need a KaTeX renderer, and the baseline category are not included, so this mean is not comparable with the published Overall column. Script: src/scripts/score_olmocr.py.
cost_note: Wall seconds per page on this machine's CPU (no GPU, no MPS), at low priority while other jobs ran (load average 7 to 30), so read the ratios, not the absolute times; they were not taken under the bench lock. QASPER: 277 born-digital pages; olmOCR sample: 110 single pages, many scanned, where OCR dominates. Marker ran as one batch, so its figure is the batch time divided by pages.
